verses.text: Blessed is he that considereth the poor: Jehovah will deliver him in the day of evil.

segments.text: Blessed is he that considereth the poor:
Jehovah will deliver him in the day of evil.

verses.text: Jehovah will preserve him, and keep him alive, And he shall be blessed upon the earth; And deliver not thou him unto the will of his enemies.

segments.text: Jehovah will preserve him, and keep him alive,
And he shall be blessed upon the earth;
And deliver not thou him unto the will of his enemies.

verses.text: Jehovah will support him upon the couch of languishing: Thou makest all his bed in his sickness.

segments.text: Jehovah will support him upon the couch of languishing:
Thou makest all his bed in his sickness.

verses.text: I said, O Jehovah, have mercy upon me: Heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.

segments.text: I said, O Jehovah, have mercy upon me:
Heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.

verses.text: Mine enemies speak evil against me, saying, When will he die, and his name perish?

segments.text: Mine enemies speak evil against me,
saying
When will he die, and his name perish?

verses.text: And if he come to see me, he speaketh falsehood; His heart gathereth iniquity to itself: When he goeth abroad, he telleth it.

segments.text: And if he come to see
me
, he speaketh falsehood;
His heart gathereth iniquity to itself:
When he goeth abroad, he telleth it.

verses.text: All that hate me whisper together against me; Against me do they devise my hurt.

segments.text: All that hate me whisper together against me;
Against me do they devise my hurt.

verses.text: An evil disease, say they, cleaveth fast unto him; And now that he lieth he shall rise up no more.

segments.text: An evil disease,
say they
, cleaveth fast unto him;
And now that he lieth he shall rise up no more.

verses.text: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, Who did eat of my bread, Hath lifted up his heel against me.

segments.text: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted,
Who did eat of my bread,
Hath lifted up his heel against me.

verses.text: But thou, O Jehovah, have mercy upon me, and raise me up, That I may requite them.

segments.text: But thou, O Jehovah, have mercy upon me, and raise me up,
That I may requite them.

verses.text: By this I know that thou delightest in me, Because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.

segments.text: By this I know that thou delightest in me,
Because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.

verses.text: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, And settest me before thy face for ever.

segments.text: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity,
And settest me before thy face for ever.

verses.text: Blessed be Jehovah, the God of Israel, From everlasting and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.

segments.text: Blessed be Jehovah, the God of Israel,
From everlasting and to everlasting.
Amen, and Amen.

headings.text: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.
